tagline: An instant of brilliance is not yet a lasting explanation.
definition: A flashing or lightninglike emission; in medicine, a technique using electrical sparks to destroy superficial tissue, whose technical meaning must be distinguished from poetic uses suggesting sudden brilliance or illumination.
etymology: From Latin fulguratio, a flashing of lightning, related to fulgur, lightning; the medical sense applies the image to electrical sparking.

sections.heading: MEANING IN MOTION
sections.text: In literary language, a fulguration can be a sudden flash that interrupts darkness, whether literally lightning or figuratively an insight. Medical fulguration refers to a particular use of electrical discharge at tissue surfaces, not simply any electrical treatment. The discipline determines the appropriate reading.

sections.heading: THE CRUCIAL DISTINCTION
sections.text: The shared imagery of a spark should not blur those meanings or serve as instructions for a procedure. For an illustrated word study, branching lightning can convey the older visual sense, while a clear explanation acknowledges the specialized clinical use. Sudden insight remains a metaphor and carries no guarantee of truth.

sections.heading: VISIBILITY IN A FLASH
sections.text: Lightning can disclose many details at once without giving an observer time to arrange them into a stable account. The metaphor of fulguration therefore joins revelation to brevity. Ask what becomes perceptible in the instant and what must still be reconstructed after the illumination has passed.

sections.heading: INSIGHT NEEDS AN AFTERLIFE
sections.text: A sudden idea may feel complete because it arrives forcefully. Testing it requires slower work: articulation, comparison, and examination of consequences. The flash can begin inquiry without completing it. The sculpture preserves the branching instant while the explanation asks what evidence would justify its apparent revelation.

literary: For one splintered instant the field possessed every blade and broken fence in impossible clarity, then darkness returned, leaving the eye to mistake its brief astonishment for knowledge.
art_caption: A branching flash exposes a low field of forms for one imagined instant before darkness reclaims the scene.
